shortDescription: Get Job Event information on PowerScale

options.name: api_password
options.description: the password of the PowerScale cluster.

options.name: begin_time
options.description: Filter events that occurred after this time. Accepts epoch timestamp (numeric string) or ISO 8601 format. Mutually exclusive with I(duration).

options.name: duration
options.description: Filter events within a time window relative to the current time. Mutually exclusive with I(begin_time) and I(end_time).

options.name: end_time
options.description: Filter events that occurred before this time. Accepts epoch timestamp (numeric string) or ISO 8601 format. Mutually exclusive with I(duration).

options.name: ended_jobs_only
options.description: If set to C(true), return only events for ended jobs.

options.name: job_id
options.description: Filter events by a specific job ID.

options.name: job_type
options.description: Filter events by job type name.

options.name: limit
options.description: Maximum number of events to return per API call.

options.name: onefs_host
options.description: IP address or FQDN of the PowerScale cluster.

options.name: port_no
options.description: Port number of the PowerScale cluster.It defaults to 8080 if not specified.

options.name: verify_ssl
options.description: boolean variable to specify whether to validate SSL certificate or not. C(true) - indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. C(false) - indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.
